method: Manual source-edge digitization with rigid roll and uniform scale only. No calibrated photogrammetry; source projection remains.

P04.front_side: image LEFT, same side as front face and lower selector

P03.front_side: image RIGHT, face and button visible

front_source.symmetry_assumption: average left/right halfwidth after rigid rotation; photo not warped

interpolation: Natural cubic through visible side-edge samples, with linear endpoint continuation. Hidden points retained as annotations but excluded; gap peak is inferred, not observed.
limitations: 5px visible-edge uncertainty is a working manual mark estimate, not calibrated statistical error
Button and hand-hidden shell points explicitly excluded from interpolation input
Head and base cap endpoint continuation inferred over short unobserved edge arcs
